■Direction
Age: 30s
Personality: A gentle, kind woman with an intelligent aura.
*An acquaintance from North Flight's club days.
Tutors North Flight in her studies while doting on her like family.
North Flight naturally took to her as well, and they gradually began calling each other "Big Sister" and "Fu-chan," working hard together on academics and training.

★Request
Black Wipe
Show North Flight (Casual Clothes)

★Request
Show North Flight (Winter Uniform)

■Direction
Try hard to sound cheerful on 2nd line
What brings you here today, Yukino-chan?

Flight-saaan!
Please heeeelp meee!!

City-san invited me to an "exhibition"...! 
I mean, I'm suuuuuper happy about it, but still~!

Yep, full of energy!
Just the other day, I ate five whole bowls of rice! Five whole bowls, you know?

I'm giving it everything I've got!
I promise I'll have great news to tell you. Bye-bye, Big Sister—

Yeah... you're right, someday...
Someday I'll work hard to match that speed of yours.

As expected of Flight, you know your stuff!
Allllriiiight!! I'm offfffff!!

...Okay, got it! I want to check where I stand right now too...
Let's go all out, Bakushin O-chan♪

Even as a mere bystander, I felt that frustration. North Flight herself had to
feel it even more deeply... and yet, there was no gloom in her after finishing.

Yes! Doing that channels power right into your lower legs.
It works wonders when running up slopes, too.

The one who arrived with such vigor was Sakura Bakushin O... the sensational
speedster who debuted this year. Big things were expected from her in sprint races.

North Flight seemed well-versed not just in fashion, but across all kinds of subjects,
and whenever I saw her, countless friends were relying on her for advice.

I was so happy to see you after so long too, Fu-chan.
Seeing you look so well... really warms my heart.
Haaaaah...――!!

So you're not sure what kind of outfit would be appropriate.
In that case, could you picture what's in your closet for me?

First, Sakura Bakushin O took the lead, with North Flight calmly
biding her time right behind... And then, coming out onto the final stretch—
Oh, hello there, Trainer?

I did not! The idea just came to me, so I decided I have been waiting for you!
—Now, let us have a showdown, Flight-san!!

Just as she had done for me, North Flight was giving fashion advice
to all sorts of Umamusume. And beyond that—
—That was so close, North Flight.

Ahem! That is because I have been training hard and running in races!
However, my Bakushin intuition tells me that you should be even faster than this!

Come, come, come, come!
Let us charge ahead in fine form! BAKUSHIIIIN!!

Stamina that could contend on middle-distance courses, and speed that could
rule the sprint division... If she continues to grow from here on—

I reach for a clothes hanger displayed outside the shop.
Recalling her words, I think about what suits me best.

Though my senior's warning weighed on my mind... unable to forget
the brilliance North Flight showed for a brief moment, I watched over her—
I have been waiting for you, Flight-san!!

Amazing, Ticket-san... She's already made it all the way out there.
...Now then, time to stretch, stretch!

...Impressive, Bakushin O-chan.
It seems your speed has gotten even sharper since your debut.

As class president, I cannot overlook your Bakushin aura!
Please, show me your exemplary speed!

North Flight began accelerating with breathtaking speed.
The moment she drew level with Sakura Bakushin O, I found myself—shouting.

Winning Ticket just now... She's entering her maturation period and rumors say
she'll be debuting soon. Her conditioning looks completely dialed in.

I had thought North Flight was an independent, composed young lady.
Yet right now, she looked noticeably younger than usual.
—Thanks for today, Big Sister.

Yet North Flight merely repeated basic stretches and maintenance at the edge
of the track. It seemed true that her body couldn't handle heavy burdens.

Bakushin O-chan... um, I'm sorry.
Did we have plans or something?

My heart throbbed. Sprint, mile, middle distance... A challenge transcending
aptitude barriers never seen before. She had the raw talent... but—

—In the end, Sakura Bakushin O won by a single length.
North Flight decelerated just before reaching top speed... exactly like last time.

Fufu, I see.
You're working so hard. Such a good girl.

Turning around at the familiar voice, I saw North Flight.
Before her stood a gentle-looking woman. What caught my attention was—

First 2,000 meters, and now 1,400 meters... Watching both runs reaffirmed
the remarkable caliber of her talent—and her limitless potential.

To think she could keep pace with Sakura Bakushin O who's racing on the frontlines!
All she needs is to fully unleash that talent. If only her body were stronger...

Per North Flight's suggestion, the impromptu duel was set to 1,400 meters—
a sprint contest. Which meant... it would be a test of pure speed.

—Aah, I get it now!
I just need to run with a lower posture!

...Alright, perfect.
Maybe I'll go for a quick little run?

The next day... While walking through town lost in thought,
I spotted the clothing store I had visited with North Flight before.

Wahaha! Victory is mine!
My speed truly is super exemplary, as expected!!
